title: Willingness to Accept for Perennial Crop Adoption: The Influence of Trust in Environmental and Government Organizations
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Replacing corn crops with perennial species can decrease sedimentation, increase soil health metrics, and of particular importance for the reduction of dead zones downstream, reduce agricultural nitrate pollution. Farmers can be paid to grow perennial species, but how much they are willing to accept to do so, as well as what factors influence the amount they want, are key. Using a mail survey administered to 3,000 farmers in Minnesota, home of the headwaters of the Mississippi, we show that farmers with a higher trust of environmental organizations and state agencies are willing to accept less to replace their crops with perennial crops, particularly for longer contracts, which produce more environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 用多年生作物替代玉米，可以减少泥沙淤积，提高土壤健康指标，并且对于减少下游的“死亡区”尤为重要，它还能减少农业硝酸盐污染。农户可以被支付报酬以种植多年生作物，但他们愿意接受多少补偿，以及哪些因素影响其所要求的补偿金额，是关键问题。我们利用对明尼苏达州3,000名农户进行的邮寄问卷调查（明尼苏达州是密西西比河的发源地）发现，对环境组织和州政府机构信任度较高的农户，愿意以较低的补偿接受将其作物替换为多年生作物，尤其是对于较长期的合同，而较长期的合同能够带来更多的环境效益。

title: Innovation as a Policy Strategy for Natural Resource Protection
abstract:
Growing global food demands place major strains on water resources, including quality impairments and increased water scarcity. Drawing on the largely separate bodies of literature on externalities and technological innovation, this article develops a dynamic framework to explore the long‐term impacts of alternative policy approaches to the agricultural impacts on water resources. Environmental policies, which focus on correcting environmental externalities, lead to an overall gain because costs to farmers are more than offset by reduced environmental damages. Technology policies, which direct public investments into agricultural eco‐innovations, lead to benefits for farmers as well as the environment. Joint implementation of both types of policies leads to the largest overall gain. In principle, a technology policy alone could have greater environmental benefits than an environmental policy alone. This outcome is most likely in cases where the productivity effect of new technology is large and the cost of research is low.
Recommendations for research managers
As an alternative to traditional environmental policy, investments in research can provide win–win solutions that benefit the environment and agricultural producers.
Conceivably, eco‐innovations could lead to environmental conditions that are better than those achieved by environmental policy alone.
Adding research investments to existing environmental policy would lead to further improvements in environmental quality while also benefitting farmers.
Unlike environmental policies that are perceived to impose costs on agriculture, technology policies impart benefits to farmers and are less likely to face political opposition from industry.
Technology policies are likely to be the most effective when eco‐innovation leads to technologies that meaningfully reduce environmental impacts and also raise farm productivity.
abstract_zh:
全球日益增长的粮食需求给水资源带来了巨大压力，包括水质恶化和水资源短缺加剧。本文借鉴了外部性和技术创新两个相对独立的文献，构建了一个动态框架，用以探讨针对农业对水资源影响的不同政策途径的长期影响。以纠正环境外部性为目标的环境政策，能够带来整体收益，因为农户承担的成本会被减少的环境损害所抵消而有余。将公共投资导向农业生态创新的技术政策，既能使农户受益，也能改善环境。两类政策联合实施则带来最大的总体收益。原则上，单独的技术政策在环境效益上可能优于单独的环境政策。这一结果最有可能出现在新技术的生产率效应较大、而研究成本较低的情形中。
对研究管理者的建议
作为传统环境政策的替代，对研究的投入可以提供互利共赢的解决方案，既有利于环境，也有利于农业生产者。
生态创新有可能带来比单靠环境政策所能实现的更好的环境状况。
在现有环境政策的基础上增加研究投入，将进一步改善环境质量，同时也使农户受益。
与被认为会给农业带来成本的环境政策不同，技术政策能够为农户带来益处，并且较不容易遭遇来自产业界的政治反对。
当农业生态创新产生能够切实减少环境影响、同时提高农业生产率的技术时，技术政策最有可能发挥最大效果。

title: Sustaining the Ogallala Aquifer: From the Wells to People, A Holistic CNH Model
Economics of Water
venue: Oxford Handbook of Water Politics and Policy
abstract: Water resources provide services of economic value to different sectors through consumptive uses, non-consumptive uses, nonuse, and as a waste receptor. The diverse array of goods and services provided by water create a challenge for efficiently allocating the resource. Furthermore, water resources are often subject to market failures because they lack the conditions of excludability and rivalry. These market failures result in depleted water supplies and degraded water quality. This chapter discusses various policy approaches that have attempted to address these market failures, many of which have created additional economic inefficiencies. It also discusses some of the scale and jurisdiction issues in water management—such as local self-governing institutions and transboundary policy formation—from an economics perspective. It primarily analyzes policies affecting agricultural water use and the impacts of agriculture on water quality because agriculture is the largest user of water and is a major contributor to water quality problems.
abstract_zh: 水资源通过消耗性用途、非消耗性用途、非使用价值以及作为废物受纳体，为不同部门提供具有经济价值的服务。水所提供的各类商品和服务十分多样，这为有效配置这一资源带来了挑战。此外，由于水资源缺乏排他性和竞争性，往往存在市场失灵。这些市场失灵导致水资源枯竭和水质退化。本章讨论了为应对这些市场失灵而采取的各种政策途径，其中许多途径又产生了新的经济低效率。本章还从经济学角度讨论了水资源管理中的一些规模与管辖权问题，例如地方自治机构和跨界政策制定。本章主要分析影响农业用水的政策，以及农业对水质的影响，因为农业是最大的用水部门，也是造成水质问题的主要来源之一。

title: Efficiency of Viable Groundwater Management Policies
abstract: We investigate the relative performance of simple groundwater policies in a spatially detailed aquifer and reveal the distribution of net benefits from those policies. Groundwater policy is plagued with a high level of complexity in achieving the first best outcome, which may be costly and politically infeasible to adopt. We parameterize a 8,457-cell spatially detailed model of the northwest Kansas section of the Ogallala Aquifer and find that simple pricing, quantity, and water market policies perform poorly but can be improved upon by localized policies that are more efficient and garner more popular support. (JEL Q15, Q25)
abstract_zh: 我们在一个空间细致的含水层中考察了简单地下水政策的相对表现，并揭示了这些政策所带来的净效益分布。地下水政策在实现第一最优结果方面非常复杂，采用成本高昂且在政治上可能不可行。我们对堪萨斯州西北部奥加拉拉含水层的一个包含8,457个网格单元的空间细致模型进行了参数化，发现简单的价格型、数量型以及水权市场政策表现不佳，但可以通过更有效率且更能获得民众支持的局部性政策加以改进。（JEL Q15, Q25）

title: Land-use Choices: The Case of Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) re-enrollment in Kansas, USA
abstract: Among the important alternatives for land conservation is the US Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) that celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2015. This paper explores how landowners decide on alternative land-use choices made available by the expiration of CRP contracts in Kansas. The study uses survey data and multinomial Logit models to predict land-use choices. Two models were tested. The first model does not incorporate variables concerning farmer perceptions and attitudes about land-use choices, while the second model does. The results show that CRP re-enrollment depends on factors, such as years of experience in cropping and percent of cropland irrigated. However, when perception variables are added, the models become more robust in explaining other land choice alternatives. The results suggest that as the perception of unfairness of more inflexible environmental policy rises, these farmers may be more likely to re-enroll their marginal land in the CRP program.
abstract_zh: 美国的保护性休耕计划（CRP）是土地保护的重要途径之一，该计划于2015年迎来了30周年。本文探讨了在堪萨斯州，CRP合同到期后土地所有者如何在可选的土地利用方式之间做出决策。本研究利用调查数据和多项Logit模型来预测土地利用选择。我们检验了两个模型。第一个模型不包含关于农户对土地利用选择的认知与态度的变量，第二个模型则包含这些变量。结果表明，CRP的重新注册取决于种植经验年限和灌溉耕地比例等因素。然而，当加入认知变量后，模型在解释其他土地选择方案方面变得更加稳健。结果表明，随着农户对僵化环境政策不公平性的认知增强，这些农户可能更倾向于将其边际土地重新注册进入CRP计划。

title: The Impact of Irrigation Capital Subsidies on Common-pool Groundwater Use and Depletion: Results for Western Kansas
abstract: We examine the effects of irrigation technology subsidies using a model of inter-temporal common pool groundwater use with substitutable technology and declining yields from groundwater stocks, where pumping cost and stock externalities arise from the common property problem. We develop and simulate an optimal control analytical model parameterized for Sheridan County, Kansas, overlying the Ogallala aquifer. We contrast competitive and optimal allocations and account for endogenous and time-varying irrigation capital on water use and groundwater stock. In our analysis, we account for the labor-savings from improved irrigation technologies. We find that in the absence of policy intervention, the competitive solution yields an early period with underinvestment in efficiency-improving irrigation technology relative to the socially efficient solution, followed by a period of overinvestment. This suggests a potential role for irrigation capital subsidies to improve welfare over certain ranges of the state variables. In contrast to previous work, we find evidence that significant returns may be achieved from policy intervention. We simulate a policy scenario where an irrigation technology subsidy is implemented to explore whether such a program can capture significant portions of the potential welfare gain.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个跨期公共池塘地下水使用模型考察了灌溉技术补贴的效果。该模型包含可替代技术，以及因地下水储量而导致的产量递减，其中抽水成本和储量外部性源于公共产权问题。我们开发并模拟了一个最优控制分析模型，并以覆盖奥加拉拉含水层的堪萨斯州谢里登县为参数设定依据。我们对比了竞争性配置与最优配置，并考虑了内生且随时间变化的灌溉资本对用水量和地下水储量的影响。在分析中，我们还考虑了改良灌溉技术带来的节省劳动力效应。我们发现，在没有政策干预的情况下，竞争性解决方案在前期对提高效率的灌溉技术投资不足，相对于社会有效解决方案而言，随后又出现投资过度的阶段。这表明，在状态变量的某些范围内，灌溉资本补贴可能有助于提升社会福利。与以往的研究不同，我们发现政策干预可能带来可观的收益。我们模拟了一种政策情景，即实施灌溉技术补贴，以探讨此类计划能否获取潜在福利收益的很大一部分。

title: Water and Society: Interdisciplinary Education in Natural Resources
venue: Journal of Contemporary Water Research and Education
abstract: Natural resource management and education must account for both the natural and human components of a complex system, yet examples of such interdisciplinary approaches are still relatively rare, especially in education. This study discusses a graduate seminar on water management, developed from an interdisciplinary National Science Foundation (NSF) grant. The seminar applied constructivist pedagogy which is not only best suited for interdisciplinary work, but also allows flexibility to redesign the course components and deliverables after each evaluation cycle. While the seminar was a successful experiment, several challenges remain when implementing such courses. These challenges include not only the organization and assessment of course deliverables, but also fitting such courses into the administrative structure of the university when represented disciplines are located in several colleges across campus.
abstract_zh: 自然资源管理与教育必须同时考虑复杂系统中的自然与人文要素，然而此类跨学科的做法仍然相对罕见，在教育领域尤其如此。本研究讨论了一门关于水资源管理的研究生研讨课，该课程源于一项跨学科的美国国家科学基金会（NSF）资助项目。研讨课采用了建构主义教学法，这种方法不仅最适合跨学科工作，而且允许在每个评估周期之后灵活地重新设计课程内容和成果要求。尽管该研讨课是一次成功的尝试，但在实施此类课程时仍存在若干挑战。这些挑战不仅包括课程成果的组织与评估，还包括当相关学科分布于校园内多个学院时，如何将此类课程纳入大学的行政架构。

title: Transaction Costs in Payment for Environmental Service Contracts
abstract: Payment for environmental service contracts commonly require actions beyond adoption of a practice, such as undergoing specified enrollment procedures, granting consent to being monitored, and paying penalties for violations. These provisions are a bundle of attributes a landholder must accept with contract enrollment, leading to transaction costs in the contracting process. This article develops a principal–agent framework to study the links between these transaction costs and the well‐known information asymmetries between the landholders and the government agency offering contracts. Using stated choice data collected from a sample of farmers, we estimate a mixed logit model to quantify the contribution of different contract attributes on contract willingness‐to‐accept (WTA). More stringent provisions in contracts were found to raise individual WTA by widely differing amounts across farmers, but the average effects imply that overall contract supply is sensitive to stringency. From a series of microsimulations based on the estimated model, we find that transaction costs create a significant drain on the cost‐effectiveness of contracting from the agency's point of view, similar in magnitude to the inefficiency created by hidden information. Although stringent contractual terms raise program expenditures, they may be justified if they raise compliance rates enough to offset the added cost. We also simulate an implicit frontier to trace out the change in compliance needed to justify a given increase in stringency. For environmental benefits in the range of previous estimates, this analysis suggests that stringent terms would need to substantially raise compliance rates to be cost effective.
abstract_zh: 环境服务付费合同通常要求的不仅仅是采纳某项措施，还包括履行特定的登记程序、同意接受监测以及在违规时支付罚金等。这些条款构成了土地所有者在签约时必须接受的一揽子属性，从而导致签约过程中的交易成本。本文建立了一个委托-代理框架，以研究这些交易成本与提供合同的土地所有者和政府机构之间众所周知的信息不对称之间的联系。利用从农户样本中收集的陈述偏好数据，我们估计了一个混合Logit模型，以量化不同合同属性对合同受偿意愿（WTA）的贡献。研究发现，合同中更为严格的条款会提高个体的受偿意愿，但提高幅度因农户而异，不过平均效应表明，整体合同供给对条款严格程度是敏感的。基于估计模型进行的一系列微观模拟表明，从机构的角度看，交易成本对签约的成本效益构成了显著的损耗，其规模与隐藏信息所造成的低效率相当。尽管严格的合同条款会增加项目支出，但如果它们能够提高合规率，足以抵消增加的成本，那么这些条款仍可能是合理的。我们还模拟了一个隐含前沿，以描绘为论证某一程度的严格性提升所需的合规率变化。对于先前估计范围内的环境效益，本分析表明，要使严格条款具有成本效益，就需要大幅提高合规率。

title: The Simple Script Wrapper for OpenMI: Enabling Interdisciplinary Water Studies
A Simulation of Factors Impeding Water Quality Trading
venue: The Journal of Regional Analysis & Policy
abstract:
While there is substantial evidence that nonpoint sources have lower nutrient reduction
costs than point sources, experience with water quality trading (WQT) reveals a common
theme: little or no trading activity. The success of WQT seems, in part, to depend on the structure of the market created to bring buyers and sellers together to transact exchanges. To examine the ways that various market imperfections may affect the performance of a WQT market, a model is constructed which simulates a hypothetical point-nonpoint market. This paper focuses on answering the following question: How can WQT programs be designed in ways that take into account factors that result in non-optimal contracting and what are the implications (if there are any) for determining trading ratios? Here, we find that apart from any implications for environmental risk or political-economic factors, there is an economic welfare justification for high trading ratios in certain situations with limited trading information and/or other barriers to trade. Limited information and other barriers to trade which inhibit the optimal contracting of trades introduces a random element to market participation, creating a risk that high-cost sellers (low-value buyers) will transact to displace low-cost sellers (high-value buyers) who could have traded for greater gain.
abstract_zh: 尽管有大量证据表明，非点源的营养物削减成本低于点源，但水质交易（WQT）的实践经验却呈现出一个共同的主题：交易活动很少或几乎没有。WQT的成功在一定程度上似乎取决于市场结构，即为促使买卖双方达成交易而建立的市场机制。为考察各种市场不完善性如何影响WQT市场的表现，本文构建了一个模拟假设性点源-非点源市场的模型。本文着重回答以下问题：如何设计WQT项目，才能考虑到导致非最优契约的因素？这对交易比率的确定又有何影响（如果有的话）？我们发现，撇开环境风险或政治经济因素的影响不谈，在某些情形下，即交易信息有限和/或存在其他交易壁垒时，高交易比率具有经济福利上的合理性。阻碍最优契约达成的有限信息和其他交易壁垒，会给市场参与引入随机因素，从而产生这样一种风险：高成本卖方（低价值买方）可能会进行交易，取代本可获得更大收益的低成本卖方（高价值买方）。

title: Comparing the Cost-Effectiveness of Water Conservation Policies in a Depleting Aquifer: A Dynamic Analysis of the Kansas High Plains
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: This research analyzes two groundwater conservation policies in the Kansas High Plains located within the Ogallala aquifer: 1) cost-share assistance to increase irrigation efficiency; and 2) incentive payments to convert irrigated crop production to dryland crop production. To compare the cost-effectiveness of these two policies, a dynamic model simulated a representative irrigator's optimal technology choice, crop selection, and irrigation water use over time. The results suggest that the overall water-saving effectiveness can be improved when different policy tools are considered under different conditions. High prevailing crop prices greatly reduce irrigators' incentive to give up irrigation and therefore cause low enrollment and ineffectiveness of the incentive payment program. In areas with low aquifer-saturated thickness, the incentive payment program is more effective, whereas in areas with relatively higher water availability, the cost-share program could be a better choice.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了位于奥加拉拉含水层之上的堪萨斯高平原地区的两项地下水保护政策：1）为提高灌溉效率提供的成本分摊援助；以及2）为将灌溉作物生产转为旱作生产而提供的激励性支付。为比较这两项政策的成本效益，我们构建了一个动态模型，模拟了一位具有代表性的灌溉农户随时间推移所做出的最优技术选择、作物选择及灌溉用水决策。结果表明，当在不同条件下考虑不同的政策工具时，整体节水效果可以得到改善。较高的现行作物价格会大大降低灌溉农户放弃灌溉的动机，因此导致激励性支付项目的参与率低、效果不佳。在含水层饱和厚度较低的地区，激励性支付项目更为有效；而在水资源相对充足的地区，成本分摊项目可能是更好的选择。

title: Groundwater Pumping by Heterogeneous Users
Water Quality Markets: Institutional Design and Performance
venue: Aquanomics: Water Markets and the Environment (The Independent Institute)
abstract: This chapter proposes to synthesize literature on water quality trading (WQT), with particular focus on studies of possible obstacles to trading and potential means of overcoming them. It presents a simple conceptual framework of workings of a point–nonpoint WQT market. The chapter relies on this framework to interpret the literature on WQT and its inherent trading obstacles. It illustrates the impacts of some of major obstacles using an agent-based simulation. The chapter reviews the literature on WQT and related markets, focusing on explanations that have been offered for poor market performance. It considers the case of an ideal, frictionless market and the conditions under which it would occur. The chapter discusses various departures from these ideal conditions that have been discussed in the literature, each of which offers an explanation for poor market performance observed in actual WQT programs. The case of a frictionless market creates an optimal benchmark of market performance to which other market structures can be compared.
abstract_zh: 本章旨在综合水质交易（WQT）的相关文献，特别关注交易面临的障碍以及克服这些障碍的可能途径。本章提出了一个点源-非点源水质交易市场运作的简单概念框架。本章依据该框架来解读关于WQT及其内在交易障碍的文献，并利用基于主体的模拟说明一些主要障碍的影响。本章回顾了关于WQT及相关市场的文献，重点关注已提出的、用以解释市场表现不佳的各种解释。本章考虑了一个理想的、无摩擦的市场及其出现的条件。本章讨论了文献中提到的、偏离这些理想条件的各种情况，每一种情况都为实际WQT项目中观察到的糟糕市场表现提供了一种解释。无摩擦市场的情形为市场绩效设定了一个最优基准，可用于将其他市场结构与之进行比较。

title: Accessible Integration of Agriculture, Groundwater, and Economic Models Using the Open Modeling Interface (OpenMI): Methodology and Initial Results
abstract: Policy for water resources impacts not only hydrological processes, but the closely intertwined economic and social processes dependent on them. Understanding these process interactions across domains is an important step in establishing effective and sustainable policy. Multidisciplinary integrated models can provide insight to inform this understanding, though the extent of software development necessary is often prohibitive, particularly for small teams of researchers. Thus there is a need for practical methods for building interdisciplinary integrated models that do not incur a substantial development effort. In this work we adopt the strategy of linking individual domain models together to build a multidisciplinary integrated model. The software development effort is minimized through the reuse of existing models and existing model-linking tools without requiring any changes to the model source codes, and linking these components through the use of the Open Modeling Interface (OpenMI). This was found to be an effective approach to building an agricultural-groundwater-economic integrated model for studying the effects of water policy in irrigated agricultural systems. The construction of the integrated model provided a means to evaluate the impacts of two alternative water-use policies aimed at reducing irrigated water use to sustainable levels in the semi-arid grasslands overlying the Ogallala Aquifer of the Central US. The results show how both the economic impact in terms of yield and revenue and the environmental impact in terms of groundwater level vary spatially throughout the study region for each policy. Accessible integration strategies are necessary if the practice of interdisciplinary integrated simulation is to become widely adopted.
abstract_zh: 水资源政策不仅影响水文过程，也影响依赖于这些过程的、紧密交织的经济与社会过程。理解跨领域的这些过程互动，是建立有效且可持续政策的重要一步。多学科综合模型能够为这种理解提供洞见，但对于尤其是小型研究团队而言，所需的软件开发工作量往往令人望而却步。因此，有必要寻求一些实用的方法，以在不产生大量开发投入的前提下构建跨学科综合模型。在本研究中，我们采用的策略是将各个领域的模型连接起来，构建一个多学科综合模型。通过复用现有模型和现有的模型连接工具，并在不修改模型源代码的情况下，利用开放建模接口（OpenMI）将这些组件连接起来，最大限度地减少了软件开发工作。事实证明，这是构建农业-地下水-经济综合模型的一种有效方法，可用于研究灌溉农业系统中的水政策效果。该综合模型的构建为评估两种替代性用水政策提供了手段，这两种政策旨在将灌溉用水降低到奥加拉拉含水层上覆的美国中部半干旱草原的可持续水平。结果表明，对于每一种政策，经济影响（以产量和收入衡量）与环境影响（以地下水位衡量）在整个研究区域内的空间差异如何变化。如果跨学科综合模拟要被广泛采用，就必须有易于获取的整合策略。

title: Calibration of a Crop Model to Irrigated Water Use Using a Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Near-term consumption of groundwater for irrigated agriculture in the High Plains Aquifer supports a dynamic bio-socio-economic system, all parts of which will be impacted by a future transition to sustainable usage that matches natural recharge rates. Plants are the foundation of this system and so generic plant models suitable for coupling to representations of other component processes (hydrologic, economic, etc.) are key elements of needed stakeholder decision support systems. This study explores utilization of the Environmental Policy Integrated Climate (EPIC) model to serve in this role. Calibration required many facilities of a fully deployed decision support system: geo-referenced databases of crop (corn, sorghum, alfalfa, and soybean), soil, weather, and water-use data (4931 well-years), interfacing heterogeneous software components, and massively parallel processing (3.8×109 model runs). Bootstrap probability distributions for ten model parameters were obtained for each crop by entropy maximization via the genetic algorithm. The relative errors in yield and water estimates based on the parameters are analyzed by crop, the level of aggregation (county- or well-level), and the degree of independence between the data set used for estimation and the data being predicted.
abstract_zh: 高平原含水层中用于灌溉农业的地下水近期消耗，支撑着一个动态的生物-社会-经济系统，该系统的各个组成部分都将受到向与自然补给速率相匹配的可持续利用转变的影响。植物是这一系统的基础，因此，可与其他组成过程（水文、经济等）耦合的通用植物模型，是所需的利益相关者决策支持系统的关键要素。本研究探讨了利用环境政策综合气候（EPIC）模型来承担这一角色。模型校准需要一个完整部署的决策支持系统的诸多功能：包括玉米、高粱、苜蓿和大豆等作物、土壤、气象和用水数据（4931个井-年）的地理参照数据库，异构软件组件的接口，以及大规模并行处理（3.8×10^9次模型运行）。通过遗传算法进行熵最大化，我们为每种作物的十个模型参数获得了自助法概率分布。根据这些参数得出的产量与用水估计的相对误差，按作物、汇总层级（县级或井级），以及用于估计的数据集与被预测数据之间的独立程度进行了分析。

title: Groundwater Economics: An Object-Oriented Foundation for Integrated Studies of Irrigated Agricultural Systems
What is the Carbon Market: Is There a Final Answer?
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: The potential for sequestering carbon in agricultural and forestry sinks to generate carbon credits has received increased attention by legislative bodies, government and nongovernment organizations, private firms, farm managers, and universities over the last few years. This increased interest is primarily due to international regulation of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions under the Kyoto Protocol. Although the United States has not ratified the Kyoto Protocol, a voluntary market and many state and regional initiatives have been developed to reduce atmospheric concentrations of GHGs. In addition, recent legislation proposed within the United States promotes a cap-and-trade system for reducing GHGs (Pew Center 2008; RFF 2008). Since our first examination of fledging carbon credit markets and factors affecting them (Williams et al. 2005), many new markets have developed, as well as new opportunities to reduce GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 在过去几年中，农业和林业碳汇生成碳信用的潜力受到了立法机构、政府和非政府组织、私营企业、农场经营者以及大学的日益关注。这种兴趣的增加主要源于《京都议定书》对温室气体（GHG）排放的国际监管。尽管美国未批准《京都议定书》，但已经发展出了自愿性市场以及许多州和地区性倡议，以降低大气中温室气体的浓度。此外，美国国内近期提出的立法主张采用总量控制与交易制度来减少温室气体排放（Pew Center，2008；RFF，2008）。自我们首次考察新兴碳信用市场及其影响因素（Williams等，2005）以来，许多新市场已经发展起来，减少温室气体排放的新机会也随之出现。

title: Farmers' Perceived Costs of Wetlands: Effects of Wetland Size, Hydration and Dispersion
abstract: We survey landowners to investigate the costs associated with the presence of permanent or seasonal wetland areas in cropland. We find, as predicted by our conceptual model, that dispersion of wetland areas imposes substantial inconvenience costs for producers but that costs respond nonlinearly and irregularly to changes in the frequency of hydration. Producer attitudes toward conservation and environmental regulation have a significant impact on perceived costs, as do some demographic attributes. The analysis suggests that incentives to aggregate dispersed wetlands into larger contiguous areas could benefit landowners and at the same time provide a net increase in wetland area.
abstract_zh: 我们对土地所有者进行了调查，以探究耕地中存在永久性或季节性湿地所带来的相关成本。我们发现，正如概念模型所预测的，湿地分散分布会给生产者带来相当大的不便成本，但这些成本对湿润频率的变化呈非线性且不规则的响应。生产者对保护和环境监管的态度对其所感知的成本有显著影响，部分人口统计学特征也有影响。分析表明，鼓励将分散的湿地整合为更大的连片区域，既可以使土地所有者受益，同时也能带来湿地面积的净增加。

title: Attitudes of Great Plains Producers about Best Management Practices, Conservation Programs, and Water Quality
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract:
Since the adoption of the Clean Water Act in 1972, there has been increased attention paid to agricultural operations as potential contributors of surface water pollutants including sediments, nutrients, and pesticides. Many of these pollutants enter into the surface water through erosion and runoff events on cropland. Over the past 35 years, millions of dollars have been spent on the promotion, installation, and maintenance of cropland best management practices (BMPs), which have proven effective at reducing soil erosion and nutrient and pesticide runoff. Adoption of cropland BMPs is critical for restoring and protecting surface water quality in agricultural watersheds.
Because BMPs result in many societal benefits, there are various conservation programs in place through national and state agencies that encourage adoption through cost-share and incentive payments. The goal of these payments is to compensate the producer for one-time installation costs, annual operation and maintenance costs, and overall profit losses. This approach has had notable success to date; however, many producers still choose not to participate in conservation programs and/or decide not to implement BMPs on their cropland fields (Conservation Technology Information Center 2002). title: Economic Adjustments to Groundwater Depletion in the High Plains: Do Water-Saving Irrigation Systems Save Water?
abstract: A common policy prescription for conserving irrigation water is to promote more efficient or “water‐saving” irrigation technologies. We develop a risk‐programing model to quantify the effect of irrigation efficiency on irrigation water use in the High Plains, taking account of irrigation timing and well capacity limits. We find that optimal irrigation does not respond monotonically to changes in efficiency, although intermediate and high‐efficiency systems both result in less water use than an inefficient flood system.
abstract_zh: 保守灌溉用水的一项常见政策处方是推广更高效或“节水型”灌溉技术。我们构建了一个风险规划模型，以量化灌溉效率对美国高平原（High Plains）灌溉用水量的影响，同时考虑灌溉时机和水井产能限制。我们发现，最优灌溉量对效率变化并非单调响应，尽管中等效率和高效率系统均比低效的漫灌系统用水更少。

title: Incentive Compatible Pollution Control Policies under Asymmetric Information on Both Risk Preferences and Technology
Multifunctionality and Optimal Environmental Policies for Agriculture in an Open Economy
venue: Agriculture and the New Trade Agenda
abstract: Introduction Though agriculture has long been recognized as a polluter, it has also more recently been noted as a provider of non-market benefits. Examples of these public goods that are by-products of agriculture include landscape amenities, a habitat for wildlife, and the preservation of agrarian cultural heritage (OECD 1997a; 1997b; Bohman et al ., 1999). Though many of these benefits are difficult to define and measure, non-market valuation studies have found substantial non-market values for farmland in different regions around the world (Beasley, Workman, and Williams, 1986; Hackl and Pruckner, 1997; López, Shah and Altobello, 1994). The notion of agriculture providing a set of non-market goods and bads as joint products with market goods has given rise to the term “multifunctionality” (Lindland, 1998; Nersten and Prestegard, 1998; Runge, 1998). Conceptually, a “multifunctional” agriculture means that the agricultural production process is a multioutput technology, where some outputs are privately traded commodities and others are public goods. This case differs from standard environmental models where some activity in the economy generates a single externality. The realization that agriculture is multifunctional has important implications for policy-making at both the domestic and international levels. In the domestic sphere, policies aimed at the various externalities from agriculture are typically legislated and administered independently. Likewise, the economics literature almost always examines externalities in isolation, either implicitly or explicitly assuming that other (potentially related) externalities are fixed or unimportant.
abstract_zh:
引言
尽管农业长期以来被视为污染者，但近来人们也注意到它能够提供非市场效益。这类公共品作为农业的副产品，包括景观价值、野生动物栖息地以及农耕文化遗产的保护（OECD 1997a；1997b；Bohman et al., 1999）。尽管其中许多效益难以界定和衡量，非市场价值评估研究已发现世界各地的农田具有可观的非市场价值（Beasley, Workman, and Williams, 1986；Hackl and Pruckner, 1997；López, Shah and Altobello, 1994）。农业与市场商品作为联合产品产生非市场的“益品”与“害品”，这一观点催生了“多功能性”（multifunctionality）一词（Lindland, 1998；Nersten and Prestegard, 1998；Runge, 1998）。从概念上讲，“多功能”农业意味着农业生产过程是一种多产出技术，其中部分产出是可私人交易的商品，另一些则是公共品。这与标准环境模型不同，后者中经济活动只产生单一的外部性。认识到农业具有多功能性，对国内和国际层面的政策制定具有重要意义。在国内层面，针对农业各类外部性的政策通常是各自独立立法和管理的。同样，经济学文献也几乎总是孤立地考察外部性，隐含或明确地假设其他（可能相关的）外部性是固定的或不重要的。

title: Control of Nonpoint Source Pollution through Voluntary Incentive-Based Policies: An Application to Nitrate Contamination in New York
abstract: A voluntary program is developed to achieve environmental goals through the self-interested choices of farmers under environmental risk and asymmetric information. Farmers behave to maximize expected net returns, and environmental quality standards are formulated through chance constraints. Because the government may not know each farmer's soil type, policy options must be self-selecting. The model is applied empirically to nitrate leaching and runoff from corn production in three New York regions. Asymmetric information between producers and the government would impose additional cost burdens on society, but these costs are modest in the context of other farm programs.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一项自愿性计划，旨在通过农民在环境风险和信息不对称条件下的自利选择来实现环境目标。农民以预期净收益最大化为目标行事，环境质量标准则通过机会约束（chance constraints）加以设定。由于政府可能并不知道每位农民的土壤类型，政策选项必须具有自选择性。该模型应用于纽约三个地区玉米生产中的硝酸盐淋溶和径流问题。生产者与政府之间的信息不对称会给社会带来额外的成本负担，但与其他农业计划相比，这些成本并不算高。
